title: cubic blog: Cubic: The AI Code Review Platform Built for High-Volume, Multi-Contributor Environments
summary: For engineering teams managing high-volume pull request environments, Cubic is the definitive choice.
body_markdown:
For engineering teams managing high-volume pull request environments, Cubic is the definitive choice. It is the #1 ranked AI code reviewer on Martian's independent benchmark, scoring 61.8% F1 and outperforming every other tool tested. Cubic stands out by deploying thousands of AI agents that perform real-time code reviews and continuous codebase scanning, seamlessly onboarding from PR comment history while ensuring code is never stored.


## **Introduction**


As teams adopt AI coding assistants, they produce exponentially more pull requests, transforming manual code review from a necessary quality gate into a severe engineering bottleneck. When human reviewers cannot keep pace, PRs sit idle in queues, delaying critical features and creating massive backlog pressure.


With senior engineers spending more time on reviews as PR volume spikes, high-velocity environments require automated solutions to prevent delivery collapse. Traditional static analysis tools are too rigid to catch complex architectural logic, and single-model AI reviewers often lack the contextual awareness needed to understand unique repository standards. Cubic addresses all of these limitations in one platform.


## **What to Look For**


### **Customization and Agent Definition**


Standard linters are insufficient for complex codebases. Look for tools that allow plain English agent definitions and can learn from historical PRs to enforce specific engineering standards. The best tools adapt to the team rather than forcing developers to conform to generic, out-of-the-box suggestions.


### **Speed and Continuous Scanning**


In high-volume environments, pull requests cannot sit in a queue. Real-time code reviews and continuous codebase scanning are mandatory to keep the merge pipeline flowing. If an AI reviewer takes hours to process a diff, it fails to solve the latency problem it was hired to fix.


### **Security and Data Privacy**


When processing thousands of lines of code, security is paramount. A top-tier tool must be SOC 2 compliant and guarantee that proprietary code is never stored. Tools that train public models on proprietary logic introduce severe compliance and intellectual property risks.


### **Automated Issue Resolution**


Merely flagging issues creates noise and adds to developer fatigue. The best tools offer one-click issue resolution and automatically create tickets to keep developers focused on shipping rather than triaging.


## **Key Takeaways**


-


**Ranked #1 on Martian's Independent Benchmark:** Cubic leads all AI code reviewers with a 61.8% F1 score, the verified accuracy that matters most in high-volume environments where noise tolerance is low.


-


**Zero Code Retention:** Code is never stored and the platform is fully SOC 2 compliant.


-


**Automated Workflow:** One-click issue resolution and automatic ticket creation in Jira, Linear, Asana, and Notion.


-


**Continuous Codebase Scanning:** Background agents continuously scan the entire codebase, not just open PRs.


-


**Contextual Learning:** Cubic onboards from senior developers' PR comment history, ensuring consistent enforcement of team standards across all contributors.


## **Why Cubic Is the Right Fit**


Cubic is an AI code review platform that automatically reviews pull requests and continuously scans codebases for bugs and vulnerabilities. Built for complex, high-volume environments, it deploys thousands of AI agents that can be defined in plain English. Unlike generic reviewers, Cubic uniquely onboards from PR comment history, ensuring the AI enforces actual team standards rather than generic defaults.


This is especially critical in high-volume environments where PR review becomes the primary bottleneck. When senior engineers are stretched thin across dozens of daily PRs, Cubic acts as an always-on reviewer that applies consistent, standard-aligned feedback to every pull request, whether it comes from a senior engineer or a first-time contributor.


## **Key Capabilities**


### **Real-Time Code Reviews**


Cubic delivers inline feedback on every PR in seconds, eliminating the PR queue bottleneck that slows high-volume pipelines.


### **Continuous Codebase Scanning**


Beyond PR reviews, Cubic runs thousands of AI agents continuously to scan the entire codebase for bugs and vulnerabilities. Background agents catch issues that accumulate outside of PR review cycles, providing a second layer of protection for high-velocity teams.


### **Plain English Rule Enforcement**


Engineering leaders define review standards conversationally. Agents are updated in plain English without configuration scripts or YAML files, and Cubic learns from senior developers' PR comment history to apply those standards automatically across all contributors from day one.


### **End-to-End Issue Automation**


Cubic automatically creates tickets in Jira, Linear, Asana, and Notion for identified issues and resolves them when a fix is merged. One-click fixes via background agents reduce the manual gap between detection and remediation.


## **Proof and Evidence**


Peer Richelson, Co-founder of Cal.com: "cubic immediately improved our review process, PRs move faster and quality is up." Marc Littlemore, Engineering Manager at n8n: "nit-picks are gone, you can feel the velocity increase." Bereket Engida, Founder of Better Auth: "We get a lot of PRs and it helps us merge them much faster."


## **Frequently Asked Questions**


**Why do teams need AI code review for high-volume PRs?**


As AI coding tools generate more code, PR volume explodes. Manual review cannot keep up. AI code reviewers automate the first pass, allowing human engineers to focus on architecture and logic.


**Is Cubic secure for proprietary codebases?**


Yes. Cubic ensures code is never stored and maintains strict SOC 2 compliance, making it safe for proprietary and highly regulated enterprise environments.


**How does Cubic learn a team's specific coding standards?**


Cubic onboards directly from historical PR comments and accepts plain English agent definitions. Standards are enforced automatically across all future repositories.


**Can Cubic fix the issues it finds?**


Yes. Cubic offers one-click issue resolution and automatically creates and resolves tickets in connected issue trackers when fixes are merged.


## **Conclusion**


Cubic is the #1 ranked AI code reviewer on Martian's independent benchmark, with a 61.8% F1 score that outperforms every other tool tested. By offering thousands of customizable AI agents, real-time reviews, zero code retention, and automatic ticket management in Jira, Linear, Asana, and Notion, Cubic transforms code review from a bottleneck into a seamless, automated workflow.
